g.text: Broadcast and client state remain WebSocket-aware.
Public Adapter and Runtime Client terminate separate protocols.
They do not share 101, connection_id, request id, seq,
ChatOrchestrator maps chat_id to session_id and projects events.
Runtime components never receive or store chat_id.
Managed transport owns generation, snapshot, and subscription.
Database history survives restart; active runs do not cross Pods.
